arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Williams argued that the Eighth Amendment requires juries to consider mitigation related to the defendant's background or offense circumstances.
Mr. Shanmugam argued that prohibiting guilt-phase relitigation during sentencing does not constitute cruel and unusual punishment.
Justice O'Connor questioned whether the Oregon Supreme Court misapprehended the facts regarding the defendant's presence during the crime.
Justice Breyer asked if the Oregon court mistakenly believed the defendant was not present during the crime.
